title: She started on a factory floor. She now runs a $27.9 billion company - and is about to spin off another.

sources.text: Fortune, May 2026 - Flex CEO Revathi Advaithi to lead Axiom Solutions International spin-off
Flex Ltd. investor relations, May 2026 - Axiom Solutions International spin-off announcement

caption:
She started on a factory floor. She now runs a $27.9 billion company - and is about to spin off another.

Advaithi rose from an entry-level factory-floor supervisor role to lead Flex, a $27.9 billion global manufacturing giant and in May 2026 announced she would lead a spin-off, Axiom Solutions International, built around Flex's booming power business for AI data centers.

Born and educated in India, Advaithi worked her way up through operations roles across multiple manufacturing companies before reaching Flex's top job - and the segment she's spinning off now sits squarely inside the global AI infrastructure boom.

Advaithi's path runs through decades of operations work most executives skip - and lands her leading a business at the center of the infrastructure race behind every AI data center being built today.
